change: Revalidate shared-summary access in an open or restored browser tab

behavior.background: clear visible content and abort request
behavior.resume: visibility/pageshow/focus require a fresh access check
behavior.terminal_denial: clear content and stop periodic retry until explicit resume
behavior.network_failure: clear content and retry while visible
behavior.stale_response: ignored after suspension, timeout, replacement request or unmount

limits: Component tests control fetch and browser lifecycle events. Actual Android browser evidence is reported separately. Physical devices, iOS and live speech remain unverified.
